title: Bachelor 1 Scholarships – Students from Italy
description: The Università della Svizzera italiana (USI) offers several scholarships for Italian students enrolled in the first year of a Bachelor’s programme, who have demonstrated outstanding merit upon obtaining their secondary school diploma and who are facing financial hardship.

The Università della Svizzera italiana (USI) offers several scholarships for Italian students enrolled in the first year of a Bachelor’s programme, who have demonstrated outstanding merit upon obtaining their secondary school diploma and who are facing financial hardship.
